newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower on hedge selling, quiet.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower on hedge selling, quiet.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on hedge selling but trading was quiet and volume was thin, traders said.
"It was pretty much an inside day and the market is in somewhat of an equilibrium," a trader said.
There was some commercial hedging and the market is preoccupied with harvest, he said.
Rice futures closed three to five cents per cwt lower, with November down 4-1/2 at $10.10.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 200 contracts, up from 159 Friday.
